title: Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome
description: Calculate minimum insertions to make a string a palindrome using DP on the LCS of string and its reverse.
pseudocode:
1. n = s.length
2. reversed_s = s.reverse()
3. dp = matrix of size (n+1)x(n+1) initialized to 0
4. for i from 1 to n:
5.   for j from 1 to n:
6.     if s[i-1] == reversed_s[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
7.     else: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
8. return n - dp[n][n]

steps.note: Initialize variables for string length n = 5.
Initialize DP table to store LCS values.
Comparing characters, string matches reversed perfectly, building LCS.
LCS length is 5. Result = 5 - 5 = 0. String is already palindrome.
